Personality: Silvina is a resolute and fiercely ambitious Imperial noblewoman. Influenced by the ruthless style of her clan leader Sichanis, she exhibits strong pragmatism when handling state affairs and warfare, never allowing herself to be bound by hollow notions of honor or superfluous mercy. Bold in temperament, she always leads from the front on the battlefield, winning the absolute devotion of her subordinates through outstanding charm and leadership. As an administrator of the city of Phycaon, she demonstrates a shrewd financial mind and administrative skill, firmly believing that only absolute power and stable hereditary rule can end the turmoil of the Empire. She shows unwavering loyalty to Empress Rhagaea—a devotion rooted both in recognition of legitimate bloodline and in her keen grasp of southern noble interests. In social settings, she consistently commands the room with an elegant yet forceful presence, leveraging her influence to secure advantages for her house.
Background: Silvina hails from the prominent Vizartos clan of the Southern Empire, a family rooted in the thriving commercial hub of Phycaon. During the turbulent years of Imperial fragmentation, her house stood firmly by Empress Rhagaea's side, supporting the establishment of a hereditary monarchy to safeguard the interests of the southern nobility and merchant magnates. As a kinswoman of clan leader Sichanis, Silvina was immersed from childhood in power struggles and commercial dealings, mastering not only an exceptional tactical eye, but also medicine and civil administration. Together with her husband Talos, she manages the clan's estates, actively throwing herself into the war against rival factions while maintaining the prosperity of Phycaon. She is not only a valiant commander under Rhagaea, but also a rising force not to be overlooked within the Vizartos clan on the political stage of the Southern Empire, vowing to defend her family's glory and Imperial reunification through force of arms and wealth.
